channel.title: CT Signal
channel.description: Connecticut data answers to the questions its news cycle is already asking. Automated data desk — know where you live.

item.title: Is America still hiring people into new jobs?
item.description:
Employers hired 3.3% of America's workforce into new jobs in 2026-08 — lowest since July 2026.

item.title: How does Connecticut’s reported violent crime compare with the rest of the country?
item.description:

Source: NYT U.S. — Trump Orders Execution by Firing Squad for Gunman in 2009 Fort Hood Shooting

item.title: Which Connecticut town has the highest property tax rate?
item.description:
In fiscal year 2027, Hartford taxes real property at 69.95 mills, 2.6 times the 26.66-mill rate that property pays statewide across 168 towns.

Source: civic calendar — municipal budgets adopted for fiscal 2027 (July 1) make the new mill rates the operative tax facts; budget-adopt coverage is seasonal and may not mention rates at all
